ownership_summary: Stephen M. Ross, who acquired the Dolphins in 2009, controls the team through Ross Sports & Entertainment, which also holds Hard Rock Stadium, the F1 Miami Grand Prix and an interest in the Miami Open. Ares Management funds bought 10% and Nets owners Joe Tsai and Oliver Weisberg 3% (Dec 2024, at an $8.1bn valuation); Xiaomi co-founder Lin Bin agreed to buy 1% at a $12.5bn enterprise valuation in March 2026. Other listed partners include Bruce Beal and celebrity holders since the Ross era began.
